title: Category page with one closing section
when: The store-wide subscription already sits on category pages.
evidence: the listing and the subscription on about 1 in 7 default category pages

steps.note: The store-wide subscription keeps the preset chosen on home: `section set` restyles it on every page. Only where it already sits on this page: `section add` makes an independent copy, not the shared one. At most one section after the grid.

notes: A promo duo of tiles after the grid only when both tiles link to pages that exist.
